set.body: Route synchronous reads, asynchronous browser reads, and JVM create-only writes through the same compiled program semantics. Supply dependency-free built-ins for bytes and CRC32C plus platform gzip adapters; inject immutable runtime capabilities at open/create boundaries and remove gzip-specific plumbing and executor pattern-match duplication. Preserve bounded decoding, ownership, receipts, and deterministic output. Gate: all existing direct and sharded fixtures pass on JVM and Scala.js, writer output remains byte-compatible with Zarr-Python, and the core gains no runtime dependency.
set.title: Zarr Z6.2: unify JVM and Scala.js codec interpreters
